summary.business_type: E-commerce store for solar, battery, backup-power, EV, and appliance products
top_findings: Apex domain is not reliably reachable; canonical www host works.
Several important title tags are longer than search display guidance.
Core Web Vitals require a later PageSpeed/CrUX run because the endpoint returned 429.
quick_wins: Shorten shop, product, and guide title templates.
Add tested X-Content-Type-Options and Referrer-Policy headers.

findings.title: Apex host reliability
findings.description: The canonical www host returns 200, but the apex HTTPS host timed out in the audit.
findings.recommendation: Fix DNS/deployment routing and permanently redirect apex HTTP/HTTPS to the canonical www host.

findings.title: Incomplete security headers
findings.description: HSTS is present; X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, and CSP were absent in sampled responses.
findings.recommendation: Add and test these headers without breaking commerce assets or support links.

findings.title: Authority signals can grow
findings.description: Guides are substantial, but visible authorship, credentials, and primary-source citations are limited in sampled pages.
findings.recommendation: Add human editor attribution, update dates, and cited first-party/manufacturer guidance.

findings.title: Long title tags
findings.description: Sampled /shop, product, and guide titles measured 74, 66, and 75 characters.
findings.recommendation: Tighten title templates while retaining product model and category intent.

findings.title: Breadcrumb schema opportunity
findings.description: OnlineStore and Product/Offer markup were detected; BreadcrumbList was not detected in sampled pages.
findings.recommendation: Add valid BreadcrumbList JSON-LD matching visible navigation.

findings.title: CWV not measured
findings.description: PageSpeed Insights returned HTTP 429 during the audit.
findings.recommendation: Repeat mobile PSI/Lighthouse and record LCP, INP, and CLS after rate limits clear.

findings.title: Strong crawler foundation
findings.description: SSR pages, llms.txt, structured data, and explicit AI crawler access are present.
findings.recommendation: Invest in original expertise, citations, and legitimate brand authority rather than AI-specific gimmicks.

findings.title: Sampled alt coverage passes
findings.description: All sampled image elements had alt attributes and product pages exposed galleries.
findings.recommendation: Continue monitoring image dimensions, format, and gallery URL availability.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Fix apex DNS and canonical redirect

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Submit and monitor sitemap in Search Console

artifacts.screenshots_dir: not generated; browser screenshot automation was unavailable
